stories.headline: United States forces hit Iranian military targets after attacks on shipping and American troops
stories.body:
United States forces began striking military targets inside Iran at noon on Tuesday [c1]. US Central Command announced that the strikes targeted the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps [c1]. It said the operation responded to attempted attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz [c2]. US Central Command said forces also reacted to attacks against American service members [c2]. About 20% of the world's oil passes through the Strait of Hormuz [c13].

Iranian state media reported explosions on Qeshm Island on the northern side of the Strait of Hormuz [c3]. Iranian news agency Nour News reported explosions in the port city of Bandar Abbas [c4]. Nour News also reported explosions in the port city of Chabahar [c4]. Iranian state media said US strikes hit a fishmeal factory on Qeshm Island [c14]. Strikes also hit a fishing pier in Sirik [c14]. State media said a maritime tower in Sirik was hit too [c14]. US strikes also hit an area outside Jiroft Airport [c14].

The Iranian Red Crescent reported that four people died in Sirik [c8]. It said a four-year-old child was among those killed [c8]. Missile shrapnel hit a wedding celebration in Sirik [c8]. The Red Crescent said that more than 50 people were injured [c8]. US Navy Captain Tim Hawkins said the US military never targets civilians [c9]. Hawkins said that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps does target civilians [c9].

The Revolutionary Guard launched a barrage of ballistic missiles at a US Marine base in Aqaba, Jordan [c10]. Iranian forces launched the missiles in response to the attack in Sirik [c10]. The Jordanian Armed Forces reported no deaths from the missile strike near Aqaba [c11]. Jordan said no injuries resulted from the attack [c11].

US President Donald Trump posted a warning on social media [c12]. Trump said Iran would be hit again at a much harder level if it retaliates [c12]. He said the next strikes would also be at a higher level [c12].

A Memorandum of Understanding in June had declared an end to fighting [c5]. That earlier fighting had killed thousands of people in Iran and Lebanon [c5]. Fighting began after US and Israeli strikes started on February 28 [c5]. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian spoke in Bishkek about the agreement [c6]. Pezeshkian said Iran would immediately reciprocate if the US returns to its commitments [c6]. Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf also issued a warning [c7]. Qalibaf said no one will export oil if enemies try to stop Iran's Persian Gulf oil exports [c7].

The strikes caused a reaction in global financial markets. Japan's 10-year bond yield reached 3% [c15]. That yield reached 3% for the first time since 1996 after the market reaction [c15]. US national government debt has risen above $40 trillion [c16]. The US Embassy in Qatar urged Americans in the Middle East to exercise heightened vigilance [c17]. The embassy warned about potential flight cancellations and travel disruptions [c17].

vocab.meaning: to respond to an action with a similar action
the state of keeping careful watch for danger

stories.headline: Germany blames Russia for Leipzig airport drone attack and orders consulate closed
stories.body:
German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt announced that Russia was responsible for an August 4 drone attack [c18]. He said Russia carried out the attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport [c18].

Security forces discovered an explosive drone near Ukrainian cargo planes at the airport on August 4 [c19]. The drone was attached to a Ukrainian cargo plane [c26]. It carried 600 grams of explosives [c26]. The device failed to detonate because of a faulty detonator [c19].

German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul announced the ordered closure of the Russian consulate in Bonn [c20]. Germany also announced it will terminate the contract for the Russian House cultural centre in Berlin [c21]. Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova said Moscow would respond in a mirror-image fashion [c22].

German investigators reported finding double-digit numbers of explosive devices near a power substation in Brandenburg [c23]. They said the devices were an attempt to cause a regional power outage [c23]. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha warned that the attack is part of Russia's deliberate strategy toward Europe [c24]. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte declared full solidarity with Germany after the attack [c25]. Germany is backing a European Commission sanctions package covering 1,600 companies linked to Russia [c27].

vocab.meaning: a device used to trigger an explosion
a facility in an electrical grid that changes voltage

stories.headline: Russian strikes kill at least 12 people in Kyiv while targeting Ukrainian railways
stories.body:
Russian strikes killed at least 12 people in Kyiv overnight [c33]. The attacks injured more than a dozen people [c33]. Six Ukrainian railway workers were killed when a missile hit a locomotive depot in Kyiv on Tuesday [c29]. A Russian ballistic missile hit the depot [c29].

Four people were killed in Boryspil near Kyiv when a strike hit a residential building [c34]. A 26-year-old Indian national was killed in Boryspil on his birthday [c35]. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Russian President Vladimir Putin to move toward peace [c36]. Modi spoke to Putin in Kyrgyzstan [c36].

Russia has struck Ukraine's railway network more than 1,500 times in 2026 [c31]. Those strikes damaged 249 carriages and 492 locomotives [c31]. Since Russia's full-scale invasion began, 58 Ukrainian railway staff have been killed [c30]. At least 318 railway workers have been injured [c30]. Ukrzaliznytsia operates 15,000 miles of track as Ukraine's largest company [c32].

Ukrainian air defences shot down 187 out of 218 drones launched by Russia [c38]. Air defences also downed five Iskander ballistic missiles, two Banderol cruise missiles, and five Kalibr cruise missiles [c38]. A Ukrainian drone strike hit the Russian Baltic Sea port of Ust-Luga, triggering a fire [c37]. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that Ukrainian drones will continue operating over Russian airspace [c28]. According to AFP analysis, Russian forces captured 35 square miles of Ukrainian territory during August 2026 [c40]. US defence manufacturer Lockheed Martin produces about 600 Pac-3 Patriot interceptor missiles per year [c39].

vocab.meaning: a powered rail vehicle used for pulling trains
a missile designed to destroy incoming enemy missiles

stories.headline: Nepal flash flood death toll reaches 1,050 as rescuers search for missing workers
stories.body:
Flash floods in Nepal killed 1,050 people by Tuesday evening [c50]. Around 4,000 people remain missing [c50]. Nearly 600 foreigners from 39 countries are among the missing [c50].

The flash flood began in Tibet on August 26 [c43]. A catastrophic collapse of rock and ice sent debris through two river systems into Nepal [c43]. Debris flowed through the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river systems [c43]. Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority reported 987 bodies recovered by Tuesday morning [c44]. The agency said 11,814 people were rescued [c44]. It reported 3,916 people missing at that time [c44]. Rescuers prioritized searching for at least 900 missing workers at 12 hydropower projects [c47]. More than 600 hydropower workers were feared trapped in tunnels north of Bidur [c45].

An Indian tunnel rescue team established a foothold in tunnels in Chilime using improvised floats [c49]. India's Ministry of External Affairs reported that 163 Indian nationals were rescued from Nepal [c48]. It said 151 Indian nationals left China as of September 1 [c48]. India sent a consignment of 37.5 tonnes of relief material, medicines, and food packets [c51]. That delivery brought total Indian emergency aid to 47.5 tonnes [c51].

Five Australians were confirmed safe, reducing the number of unaccounted-for Australian citizens to 38 [c41]. Australia's Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade received nearly 800 calls [c42]. Australia dispatched 18 personnel to Nepal [c42]. Africa Disaster Relief searched for six missing South Africans along the border between Nepal and China [c46].

vocab.meaning: causing sudden great damage or suffering
a quantity of goods delivered to a recipient

stories.headline: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urges Shanghai Cooperation Organisation members to dismantle terror networks
stories.body:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed leaders at the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit on September 1 [c54]. Modi spoke in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, urging member states to dismantle terrorist ecosystems [c54].

Summit leaders adopted the Bishkek Declaration [c56]. The declaration called for an inclusive government in Taliban-ruled Afghanistan [c56]. Leaders also expressed concern over the conflict in West Asia [c56]. Modi said the crisis in West Asia must be resolved through dialogue and diplomacy [c59]. He said the conflict should not be resolved on the battlefield [c59]. SCO leaders adopted joint initiatives on combating drug addiction and conserving biodiversity [c60]. Leaders also agreed to create the SCO Green Technology Corridor for 2026-2030 [c60]. Pakistan assumed the role of SCO chair for the 2026-2027 term [c55].

Modi held a brief exchange with Chinese President Xi Jinping during the summit in Bishkek [c57]. He also held a bilateral meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin [c57]. Trade between India and Russia rose from around $13 billion in 2021 to nearly $60 billion in 2025 [c58]. Indian imports of Russian crude oil largely drove that trade growth [c58].

In a video message from Kyrgyzstan, Modi repeated his appeal for Indian citizens to change spending habits [c61]. Modi urged citizens to avoid foreign vacations [c61]. He asked people to avoid destination weddings abroad [c61]. Modi also urged citizens to avoid non-essential gold purchases [c61]. The unit value of gold imports to India moderated to $2.8 per kg [c53]. That price was 47% higher than a year earlier [c53]. The unit value was down from $3.5 per kg in June [c53].

Modi praised India's economic resilience during his summit remarks [c52]. India's gross domestic product grew at 7.8% in the April-June quarter [c52]. That GDP growth surpassed the Reserve Bank of India's forecast of 7% [c62].

vocab.meaning: involving or agreed by two sides or countries
